## I9
One-Sentence Story: Memory training can fail because successful demonstrations conceal the histories needed to recover from deviations.
Theme: Data Engines
Direction Axis: memory-learning-and-transfer
Target Failure: missing-history
Direction Evidence: Training histories determine recovery actions after execution deviations.
Form: new mechanism or new problem
Summary: Generate observation-matched histories whose correct recovery actions differ.
Minimal Falsification Experiment: Construct 2,000 paired histories; fine-tune with 2 A100s; evaluate 500 unseen recovery trials against validation-best ordinary augmentation and intervention-data training. Match transitions and failures; shuffle history-action assignments. Expect 10-point recovery gain; kill below 3 points over intervention data.
Why It May Be Novel: History identifiability as a data selection criterion requires directed verification.
